title: The Cold Coffee
scene: At 12:40 PM, the cafe espresso machine was sabotaged. The kitchen gas was shut off from 12:30 to 12:55.

suspects.name: Mara Lund
suspects.testimony: I was taking orders at the counter at 12:40, machine or no machine.
suspects.alibiProof: The counter camera shows Mara serving at 12:38 and 12:43.

suspects.name: Gideon Pike
suspects.testimony: I was checking the gas valve in the kitchen at 12:40.
suspects.contradiction: The gas valve needs a key held only by Gideon, and coffee grounds were in his pocket.

suspects.name: Leila Sato
suspects.testimony: I was clearing tables in the back room at 12:40.
suspects.alibiProof: Leila's tray log shows table six cleared at 12:39.

suspects.name: Oscar Reed
suspects.testimony: I was unloading crates at the side door at 12:40.
suspects.alibiProof: The delivery app shows Oscar's scan at 12:41.
